title: The rainbow glass stair
alt: Translucent colored-glass stairs rise through a pale museum beneath a rectangular skylight.
description: An architectural study combines continuous stair geometry, transparent rails and spectral light.
prompt: A refined architectural photograph inside a pale modern art museum. A single broad staircase of translucent coloured-glass treads rises continuously from left foreground to an upper-right landing. Each tread rests on visible brushed-steel stringers; clear balustrades connect neatly along both sides. Coloured light falls in a subtle spectrum across the white floor, with a tall rectangular skylight overhead. Complex realistic refraction, coherent tread spacing and supports, no people or text.
